info.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Create Scheduled Action

params.name: ScheduledActionName
params.description: The name of the scheduled action. The name must be unique within an account. For more information about this parameter, see ScheduledAction.

params.name: TargetAction
params.description: A JSON format string of the Amazon Redshift API operation with input parameters. For more information about this parameter, see ScheduledAction.

params.name: Schedule
params.description: The schedule in at( ) or cron( ) format. For more information about this parameter, see ScheduledAction.

params.name: IamRole
params.description: The IAM role to assume to run the target action. For more information about this parameter, see ScheduledAction.

params.name: ScheduledActionDescription
params.description: The description of the scheduled action.

params.name: StartTime
params.description: The start time in UTC of the scheduled action. Before this time, the scheduled action does not trigger. For more information about this parameter, see ScheduledAction.

params.name: EndTime
params.description: The end time in UTC of the scheduled action. After this time, the scheduled action does not trigger. For more information about this parameter, see ScheduledAction.

params.name: Enable
params.description: If true, the schedule is enabled. If false, the scheduled action does not trigger. For more information about state of the scheduled action, see ScheduledAction.

items.docs: Creates a scheduled action. A scheduled action contains a schedule and an Amazon Redshift API action. For example, you can create a schedule of when to run the ResizeCluster API operation.
